Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.renderconfig

Record Class ItemRenderConfig

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.renderconfig.ItemRenderConfig
public record ItemRenderConfig(@Nullable RenderMode mode, @Nullable Float scale, @Nullable RenderOffset offset) extends Record
One override entry in the shared override vocabulary. Every field is optional; an entry owns an item's presentation, so fields it omits take plain defaults (scale 1, zero offset) rather than measured values. An omitted mode is the sole exception and is measured.
